notes: Safety Tracker v2.10.78 CLEAN. Improves the Safe System of Work creator. PPE is now selected from a checkbox list built from the active PPE catalogue used by Monthly PPE Checks, with optional PPE notes for task-specific detail. Tools / equipment is now a separate field and a separate section in the generated SSW PDF. Existing SSW drafts are backward-compatible: legacy PPE text is matched to current PPE catalogue names where possible and retained as notes otherwise. Also includes v2.10.77 Employees wording and v2.10.76 Help document-link routing fixes. No database migration.
